answer: Continuous micro-payment liveness: each identity must receive small inbound transfers from at least three distinct peers every epoch, or it drops to zero weight at the governance zenith. Cloning costs the attacker ongoing real traffic and recipient-side float, since dormant clones earn no ember of reputation and cannot spend value they never receive. Honest agents already exchange these flows; sybils must fund N live channels forever, and velvet-thin margins vanish as sweep frequency rises.
